basic_info.description: Just reduced to the Buy it Now Price. An opportunity not to be missed to own this ultra luxurious, top floor residence in the heart of The Castro on a quiet, tree lined street. The residence includes high ceilings, 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 modern bathrooms, a private deck overlooking Eureka Valley, a beautifully landscaped garden and large enclosed parking. Features include intricate moldings, hardwood floors and custom lighting throughout, soaring ceilings, an abundance of natural light, a marble fireplace in the grand living room, a modern kitchen that opens up to a private deck, and expansive views throughout the residence. Added bonus is the large attic with possible expansion potential as well as low HOA's. Steps away from all of the excitement, conveniences and great restaurants in the Castro. A property not to be missed!
